PII Schema — POST /par > OpenAPI definition #/components/schemas/AEBankServiceInitiationRichAuthorizationRequests.AECreditorAccountTypeCodes

{
 "type": "string",
 "enum": [
 "Individual",
 "Merchant",
 "Business",
 "Charity",
 "GovernmentBody",
 "Other"
 ],
 "description": "The Creditor (Payee) Type, based on an allowed list. This value is populated by TPPs to inform the User of the type of Creditor being authorized, which facilitates providing information during the Consent journey."
}
